newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Esselte sells part of Bensons' to Hong Kong group.
newsitem.headline: Esselte sells part of Bensons' to Hong Kong group.

text.p: Swedish office supplier Esselte said on Wednesday that its subsidiary Bensons sold its manufacturing operations to Hong Kong based group World Wide Stationery.
The sale is part of a longterm cooperation agreement between Bensons, which is headquartered in Hong Kong, and World Wide Stationery, Esselte said in a statement.
Bensons' marketing operations are not affected by the deal, which is expected to strengthen both companies' competitiveness, it said.
For Esselte, the deal means that working capital will decrease by about 40 million crowns and the number of employees will fall by 470.
